global: This is miso ramen, its rich, amber broth glistening with oil. Topped with menma and shredded green onions, it sits in a brown-rimmed bowl against a bright white background, lit evenly to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: The surface is smooth, white, and flat, with subtle shadows and faint creases near the bowl's edge.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a brown rim, cream-colored body with black calligraphy, and smooth, slightly glossy surface.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and bamboo shoots, appears rich, golden-brown, and slightly frothy on its surface.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly textured surface and rounded, curved shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, and fibrous strips with a soft, chewy texture.
